_note: TUNED from live DOM 2026-06-09 (real episode playing, container Chrome+Widevine — Prime PLAYS, full automation, no OBS). VOD only (Grabar Serie/Película); no live/EPG block. Prime UI hashed FluentUI classes (fqye4e3…) are volatile — anchor aria-label (English, stable) + visible text. Player controls expose ENGLISH aria (Fullscreen/Volume/Pause/Close Player/Seek); skip-intro/next-episode are visible TEXT with no aria/testid. Account UI was English; selectors also cover Spanish (es_ES) for group-shipped users.
_audio_note: Prime does NOT decouple <video>.muted from its UI the way Pluto's React player did — element-level unmute (orchestrator._ensure_audible) is the real lever and just works (video.muted=false observed live with sound). Player mute toggle aria='Volume' carries no mute/unmute substring, so adapter.mute_state() returns None on Prime → the 'm'-press durability net stays idle, which is fine here. mute_key='m' kept as belt-and-suspenders.
_skip_next_note: skip_intro + next_episode CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-10 (Fallout). skip_intro: button.atvwebplayersdk-skipelement-button, text 'Omitir resumen' (recap) — same button class handles intro/recap, locale-immune class is primary. next_episode: the 'A continuación' card mounts at credits — click target is [class*='atvwebplayersdk-nextupcard-button'] (text 'E 6…'); DO NOT match the sibling atvwebplayersdk-nextupcardHIDE-button ('Ocultar'/dismiss) — the [class*='nextupcard-button'] substring excludes 'nextupcardhide-button' cleanly. Both gated with :visible because the nextupcard-wrapper stays mounted (vis:false) between uses. Card title 'A continuación' kept as text fallback. Prime autoplays the next ep if the card is left alone (boundary_src covers it).
_ad_note: AD MARKER LIVE-PROVEN 2026-06-10 on an ad-tier account (3 breaks/episode, breaks STACK — 20s then 35s back-to-back). Prime uses SERVER-SIDE ad stitching: the SAME <video> blob plays, content dur stays full-length (~3815s) and currentTime keeps advancing THROUGH the ad — so duration/blob heuristics are useless, the DOM overlay is the only signal. Stable marker (atvwebplayersdk-* prefix is locale-immune; the hashed FluentUI classes are not): 'atvwebplayersdk-ad-timer' is the container, with aria 'Reproduciendo anuncio. El contenido se reanudará dentro de N minutos y M segundos.' and visible text 'Anuncio0:20'; children atvwebplayersdk-ad-timer-text / -ad-text ('Anuncio') / -remaining-time ('0:20', counts down). CSS-visibility matters: the trap had to filter visibility:hidden/opacity nodes (e.g. atvwebplayersdk-ad-resume-message reports a non-zero rect while CSS-hidden = false positive). 'Continuar sin anuncios' (atvwebplayersdk-go-ad-free-button) is the UPSELL, present always — NEVER match it.
_fullscreen_note: player_fullscreen=false (§20.5n): requesting element-fullscreen on Prime's <video> reloads its surface (cover/loading flash) and fullscreen drops, so the orchestrator's per-poll re-assert THRASHED it every ad_poll seconds (flight 20260610-174551: fullscreen_reassert 5/7 polls). --kiosk already fills the capture display, so player-fullscreen is redundant here. The operator's double-click 'fixed it' momentarily by winning the thrash race.
